If I *don't* rank w as my first choice, I might get blocked from w by someone who ranks w higher, even though I'm a high-priority applicant to w. Similarly, if I don't rank z as my second choice, I might get blocked from z.

Therefore, my ranking remains consistent with my stated preferences.
